visual_description: A horizontal row of three social media icons (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook) in white, each inside a small dark circular background, spaced evenly and centered on a black background with padding. Each icon is a clickable link to the respective brand's social media profile.
purpose: Provides quick links to the brand's social media accounts, encouraging recipients to engage with and follow the brand on external platforms. Enhances connectivity and brand presence beyond the email.
rag_text: The HTML snippet is a social section component found at the email footer, displaying Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook icons as inline links. The section uses a black background with centered alignment and padding, encouraging engagement with the brand's social profiles.
